column15: Except for ENABLED, you can have any number of columns of each type.
If the column ENABLED is included, rows set to FALSE will be omitted.
FILE gives the file path and name where the summary output should be saved, output can be divided across multiple files.
LABEL allows you to include arbitrary text in your output, this is intended to provide a description of the summary.
When the summary for the row is produced, the output is grouped by the group columns.
DISTINCT counts the number of distinct values in the column.
COUNT counts the number of non-missing values in the column.
SUM calculates the sum total of the column, during validation the tool will error is this column is not numeric.
STDDEV calculates the standard deviation of the column.
ENTITY works like DISTINCT, but will union over _min and _max suffixes too.
MAX computes the maximum of non-missing values in the column.
MIN computes the maximum of non-missing values in the column.
SEED works like SUM but first takes modulo base 100. It is intended to support consistent random rounding.
NOTES columns are ignored. Any other column names are ignored, but generate a warning.
Input in {curry brackets} is treated as R code, this is intended for making minor adjustments to variables.
